OBSERVED DEFECT TO REPAIR
The actual Verovio page-1 PNG clips the long movement title at the left edge (visible text starts with 'ead Topline with Lyrics'), and its metronome quarter-note symbol renders as an empty-square/tofu glyph before '= 160'. Pages 2 and 3 and the lyrics are otherwise legible. Repair this at the MusicXML generation source, not by painting over the PNG. Use a compact centered movement title such as 'Stardust — Lead Vocal' or another equally short title that fits fully. Replace the glyph-dependent metronome display with literal plain text 'Tempo 160 BPM' while retaining machine-readable playback tempo 160 in MusicXML (for example, a sound tempo element). Regenerate MusicXML, all SVG/PNG pages, contact sheet, score data, render report, and proof from the repaired build script. The rendered first page must visibly contain the full compact title and literal 'Tempo 160 BPM', with no clipped title and no tofu square. Keep three pages.

FINAL OUTPUT LAYOUT
Copy the complete standalone tool into /Users/macpro/Documents/Codex/2026-09-09/1-2-flash-3-bgm-4/work/antigravity-runs/stardust-r01-score-lyrics-final-20260911-r1 as the top-level application. Include the repaired build_score_bundle.py, MusicXML, MIDI, score data, render report, contract, contact sheet, and pages at top level as canonical export artifacts. Copy the repaired MusicXML, MIDI, score data, contract, contact sheet, and page SVG/PNG files into the tool's assets folder. Keep the original M4A asset unchanged. Update any embedded canonical score-data hash only if the regenerated score-data hash actually changes. Update tool-report.json and worker-proof.json so every final copied asset and top-level artifact hash is current. Add final-report.json with old/new hashes, the exact defect repair, invariant checks, readbacks, test results, and limitations.

INVARIANTS AND READBACK
- Compare all 478 source and alignment events field-for-field for start_time_seconds, end_time_seconds, pitch_candidates, duration_in_beats, bar_number, beat_number, beat_position, confidence, and uncertain. Require zero mismatch.
- Require 478 MIDI note-ons and 478 note-offs at exact source millisecond times and exact pitches, 279 MIDI lyric events, 279 MusicXML lyric elements, 29 lyric lines, 50 lyric extensions, 199 null lyric notes, and 3 pages.
- Independently parse the MusicXML with music21 and MIDI with mido. Independently load the MusicXML with Verovio and require three valid pages.
- Inspect generated page-1 SVG text content and rendered PNG pixels/layout sufficiently to prove the complete title and literal tempo text are in-bounds. Record the method and result. Do not label this a browser screenshot.
- Run node test_state.mjs and python3 test_server.py from /Users/macpro/Documents/Codex/2026-09-09/1-2-flash-3-bgm-4/work/antigravity-runs/stardust-r01-score-lyrics-final-20260911-r1. Preserve the tested playback, stop, valid/invalid A/B range, loop wrap/non-loop stop, page bounds, active-line, draft edit/reset, safe draft export, localhost serving, byte-range, MIME, traversal, and shutdown behavior.
- Verify the final app references only existing local assets and no CDN/network dependency.

REQUIRED TOP-LEVEL OUTPUTS
Every required output filename must exist directly in /Users/macpro/Documents/Codex/2026-09-09/1-2-flash-3-bgm-4/work/antigravity-runs/stardust-r01-score-lyrics-final-20260911-r1. The result is incomplete unless final-report.json and tool-report.json report PASS, worker-proof.json records the exact observed Flash route and current hashes, all tests freshly pass, and page 1 is visibly corrected. Do not write narrative outside the artifacts. Stop after producing and validating the final bundle.
